video_description: A group of five individuals sits around a rectangular table covered with a red and white checkered cloth.

Each participant places the contents of the case, which appear to be earplugs, into their ears.
The camera wearer confirms that all group members have successfully put on the earplugs.
The camera wearer holds up a smartphone displaying a digital timer set to zero.
The group discusses their plans for the final day of their current activity.
